posts.name: 30-mind-nfl-cte
posts.caption:
About 3 in 4 former NFL players who died between 2008 and 2023 likely had CTE, a new study estimates, even after correcting for which families donate brains 🧠

The catch: it is a statistical estimate built on who donates, and it says nothing about living players.

Source: Gallini, Tripodis et al. (Boston University, Mass General Brigham, Concussion & CTE Foundation), “Bias-Adjusted Prevalence of Chronic Traumatic Encephalopathy Among Deceased National Football League Players”, JAMA Network Open, 2026.
